title: AuthProvParamFwdAllowlist - Data API
description: Represents an allowlisted URL parameter that can be forwarded from authentication provider client configuration URLs to the authorization URL. Use this type to add custom functionality to authentication providers. For example, allowlist a ui_locales parameter and use it to send a user's language preference from Salesforce to the third-party provider's login page. This object is available in API version 62..0 and later.

AuthProviderId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AuthProviderId.description: The ID of the authentication provider associated with the allowlist. This field is a relationship field.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: A description for the allowlisted URL parameter.

Param.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Param.description: The name of the parameter, such as ui_locales or login_hint.
